_instructions: Copy this file outside the repository and fill every null field from the real approval record (never invent names or ticket numbers). Clear outstanding_governance only when each item is actually satisfied, then run c1_quarterly_release.py preflight. Any change to the package, candidate or restatement report invalidates it.
_release_id_format: c1-YYYYMMDD-ukpn-ev-2026q2 (date of the release; never reused)
option_policy: RESTATED: restate 2025-03..2026-03 with the 2026 Q2 DfT VEH0135 vintage and append 2026-06; all C1 quarters from March 2025 retained

rollback_reference.command: python experiments/ev_redistribution_c1/release/c1_quarterly_release.py rollback --root <repository root> --release-id <release_id> --confirm "ROLLBACK <release_id> <first 16 of the new manifest_sha256>"

outstanding_governance: named independent release approver(s) per RELEASE_CHECKLIST section A
separate authorisation to set LIVE_RELEASE_ENABLED = True for the release window and back to False afterwards
release code reviewed and committed; archive pushed to the governed remote (Git LFS)
live metadata.json (pre-existing uncommitted change) committed or explicitly accepted as the starting state
